summary: Donald Trump’s influence dominated primary night as his endorsed candidates cruised in Florida while longtime critics stumbled. Meanwhile, Alaska’s Senate race set up a key showdown for control of Congress. Bloomberg’s Derek Wallbank has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
